given: a SKU that holds no stock at any location
when: the operator opens that SKU's detail view
then: the view shows an explicit empty state indicating the SKU has no stock at any location, never a blank page or an error

independence.rationale: AC1-AC3 describe a SKU that has stock (rows, tracking code, par-level state); AC4 adds the distinct no-stock outcome, which can break (blank/error page) while the populated detail view still renders correctly.

architectural_notes: E2E: outcome is the SPA rendering an explicit empty state (never a blank page or error) when the SKU holds no stock at any location, derived from the real detail response returning zero rows. Boundary app/routes/ delegates to app/services -> app/repositories/ which returns an empty result set for that sku; the client renders the empty state. Verified end-to-end against the paired branch so the zero-row envelope is exercised as an actual client-server contract.
